Film4.uk.title: To Hell and Back
Film4.uk.description: (1955) Fact-based wartime drama. Audie Murphy, America's most decorated soldier in WWII, plays himself in this dramatic recreation of the valiant heroics that earned him the honours.

Film4.uk.title: Inglourious Basterds Interview...

Film4.uk.title: Destination Gobi
Film4.uk.description: (1953) Fact-based Second World War adventure. Richard Widmark stars as a US Navy officer who leads an alliance of scientists and tribesmen against the Japanese in Mongolia.

Film4.uk.title: Behind Enemy Lines
Film4.uk.description: (2001) Thriller with Owen Wilson. A US Navy flight officer on a NATO reconnaissance mission has to fend for himself when he's shot down by Serb forces in the former Yugoslavia. Violence.

Film4.uk.title: The King's Man
Film4.uk.description: (2021) The spy-caper franchise continues with the origins story of the Kingsman agency, as a plucky group battle an international conspiracy at the outbreak of WWI. With Ralph Fiennes.

Film4.uk.title: Knives Out
Film4.uk.description: (2019) Sharp, eccentric murder-mystery starring Daniel Craig as a detective anonymously hired to investigate the death of a wealthy writer (Christopher Plummer). With Ana de Armas.

Film4.uk.title: Career Girls
Film4.uk.description: (1997) Mike Leigh's poingnant drama stars Katrin Cartlidge and Lynda Steadman as old college friends who meet up only to discover they still suffer from emotional fragility.

Film4.uk.title: Magnificent Obsession
Film4.uk.description: (1954) Douglas Sirk's melodrama starring Rock Hudson and Jane Wyman. A playboy reforms his lifestyle in order to seek forgiveness from a woman whose husband's death he inadvertently caused.

Film4.uk.title: The Enemy Below
Film4.uk.description: (1957) Second World War thriller. Robert Mitchum stars as the captain of a US destroyer in the North Atlantic hunting down a German U-boat and its world-weary captain, Curt Jurgens.

Film4.uk.title: The Equalizer 2
Film4.uk.description: (2018) Action crime thriller sequel. Denzel Washington returns as Robert McCall, who's out for revenge after ruthless killers murder an agency contact who he also considered a friend.

Film4.uk.title: The Hunt
Film4.uk.description: (2020) Fighty, satirical horror that upset Donald Trump. Hilary Swank plays a rich lefty who likes hunting working class people to the death. But she didn't reckon on Betty Gilpin.

Film4.uk.description: (2007) Drama. Michelle Yeoh and Michelle Krusiec star as nomadic women in the Arctic tundra who, in rescuing a man (Sean Bean), instigate a deadly eternal triangle. Violent scenes.
